subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Sounds and Spelling – Unit 1, Lesson 5: Graded readers
outcomes: I can read the stories At the lake and I am six!
I can read words with ai, oa, ie and a-e.
I can name the boy's birthday presents.

tf.s: In I am six!, the boy is six.
There is a boat on the cake.
tf.why: Great! A boat is on the cake.

tf.s: There is a game in the box.
In I am six!, the boy is seven.
tf.why: The story is I am six!, so he is six.

tf.s: The boy is happy because it is his birthday.
tf.why: Well done! He has got presents.

tf.s: You and have are tricky words.
tf.why: Yes! We read them by sight.

boxes.why: The story is I am six!
There is a boat on the cake.
A boat goes on the lake.

boxes.q: Which word has ai: sail or tie?

boxes.why: My name is on this box.
It's his birthday and he has presents.

boxes.q: Tick or cross: It is a cake. (a game)
boxes.why: The picture shows a game, not a cake.

hunt.q: On the cake there is a ...
In the box: It is a ...
An oa word in At the lake
An a-e word in At the lake
Tricky word: ... have got my pie.
My (coat / boat) is on the gate.

mcq.q: Which is the name of graded reader 2?
mcq.why: Graded reader 2 is I am six!

mcq.q: Which are tricky words in the readers?
mcq.why: you and have are the tricky words.

mcq.q: Which is a present in I am six!?
Choose: You have got my (mat / boat), goat!
mcq.why: The goat has got the boat.

mcq.q: Picture of soap. Which sentence matches?
What is in your box? Write a sentence.
mcq.why: Start with a capital and end with a full stop.

mcq.q: Which group has one word from each sound ai, oa, ie, a-e?
mcq.why: sail ai, boat oa, tie ie, cake a-e.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT belong: cake, game, boat?
mcq.why: cake and game have a-e. boat has oa.

mcq.q: How do we know the boy is happy?
o: He has got presents for his birthday
